title: AION 2 Races: Elyos or Asmodians
description: Choose between AION 2 Elyos and Asmodians using official Global faction, server-pairing and transfer rules. Coordinate friends before creating your character.
summary: Choose your faction together with your region and server. Opposing server pairings determine cross-faction opponents and can change over time.
quickAnswer: AION 2’s playable faction choice is Elyos or Asmodians. Choose the same region, faction and server as your friends for shared questing; class choice is separate, and the checked sources establish no universal faction damage advantage.
